narr: Scattered thunderstorms along a frontal boundary produced heavy rain which caused flash flooding across portions of central and eastern Virginia.
ev: High water was reported on roadways at the 3800 Block of Chamberlayne Avenue.
Flash flooding was reported on Rochambeau Drive north of Williamsburg.
Flash flooding was reported on Old Williamsburg Road west of Yorktown.
Street flooding was reported. Road was closed. Vehicles were stranded.
Street flooding was reported near the intersection of Centerville Turnpike and Oxford Trace Way.
About 6-12 inches of water was on portions of Gardenwood Park near the intersection with Bayside Road.
High water was reported on Buffalo Road and causing delays near Clarksville.
Standing water was reported near the intersection of Jerusalem Plank Road and Cabin Point Road, causing delays.
One lane was closed on South Quay Road due to high water near the intersection with Holy Neck Road.
Street flooding was reported in low lying areas near Business Route 460 and Route 642.
High water was reported on Interstate 64.
There were numerous reports of street flooding in the city of Portsmouth, mainly on Airline Boulevard and Portsmouth Boulevard.
About six inches of water was reported on the road near the intersection of Belvidere Street and Canal Street.
Street flooding was reported on Monument Avenue near the intersection with Horsepen Road.
High water was reported near the intersection of Three Chopt Road and Sweetwater Lane.
Virginia Department of Highways cameras showed standing water on Belvidere Street at Canal Street.
